summary: The detector found road cracking with up to 53% confidence. Severity is High: 2 crack areas (alligator (fatigue) cracking) covering 56% of the photo. The same photo also shows a pothole (low priority, Roads and Stormwater).
recommended_action: Inspect the road base and plan resurfacing before the cracking turns into potholes.
